title: Cue
description: Normalized LiveSub subtitle cue. Every module (caption path, STT path, translation, overlay, export) speaks this format. All times are VIDEO seconds, never audio-chunk seconds.

id.description: Stable id, unique within a session (e.g. cue-001).

start.description: Video time (s) when the cue becomes active.

end.description: Video time (s) when the cue stops being active.

lang.description: BCP-47-ish language code of `text` (en, hi, mr, ta, te, ...).

translation.description: Translated text in the viewer's target language.

source.description: Where the original text came from.

speaker.description: Speaker label from diarization (Phase 6.5), e.g. S1.

is_final.description: False while the STT hypothesis may still change.

first_shown_at.description: Video time (s) at which the final text first appeared in full.

at.description: Video time (s) when this revision was received.
